name: weighted-scorecard
title: Weighted scorecard
description: A decision matrix: weighted criteria down the side, options across, a 1 to 5 score in each cell and weighted totals that name the winner or call a tie.
docs: Weights can be any positive numbers; they are shown as shares that add up to 100 percent. No option is called the winner until every cell is scored. Controlled with `scores` and `onScoreChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultScores`. `readOnly` shows plain numbers. On a phone the columns shrink so up to four options sit side by side, the winner badge shortens to Top or Tied, and the criterion descriptions stay for screen readers only. Like Crosstab table it sits in a focusable, labelled region so a sideways scroll works with the keyboard.
